United Kingdom and Ireland Programming Contest 2023

A. Assessment Disruption
int[] construct(int N);
- Construct an array A of length N where naive DAG cost O(N^3) comparisons.

B. Boat Commuter
int count_charge(int[] P);
- Compute charge of enter and visit piers in P.

C. Clearing Space
double max_area(int N, int P, int[] A);
- Pick P points in A on a circle and maximise the area.

D. Delivery Forces
int max_strength(int K, int[] A);
- Given 3K strengths in A and form K triplets to maximise the sum of median.

E. Enchanted Fortress
int best_spell(int N, int[][] D);
- The reward of a subset S of [N] is sum of D[i][j] where i, j in S.
- Find the maximum reward.

F. Fast Forward
int[] fast_forward(int N, int C, int[] D);
- Advertisement play after C seconds has passed from the last one.
- Find the number of advertisements played if start at each position.

G. Glacier Travel
double shortest_distance(double S, int N, point[] P);
- Given a path P of N points, and two persons with separation S.
- Find the actual shortest distance between the two persons.

H. History in Numebrs
void init(int N, int[] A);
- Given an array A of length N.
int range_add(int L, int R, int D);
- Add D to each elements of A[L..R].
bool check(int L, int R);
- Returns if the subarray A[L..R] has increasing local minima.

I. International Travel
optional(point[]) construct(circle[] socket, circle[] plug);
- Put the three-pin plug into the socket.

J. Journey of Recovery
int maximum_delay(int N, (int, int)[] S, (int, int)[] E, int M, int[] F);
- Given N flights from S[i] to E[i] at certain times.
- Given iternary F where you take flights sequentially.
- Output the maximum delay if one of the flights is cancelled.

K. Kernel Scheduler
int[] dependency(int N, int M, edge[] E);
- Select at least half of the directed edges in E such that no cycle is formed.

L. Last One Standing
int winner((int, int, int) P1, (int, int, int) P2);
- Given two players of health, damage and reload time.
- Simulate the fight and give result.

M. Mini-Tetris 3023
int max_rectangle(int A, int B, int C);
- Given A square tiles, B S-tiles and C corner tiles.
- Returns maximum possible width N such that N-by-2 grid can be filled.

N. Naming Wine Bottles
string[] bottle_naming(int N, double[] A);
- Name bottles such that same size corresponds to same name.
